items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The referee waves it off! That's a stoppage, folks, and a merciful one!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: STOPPED! The referee has seen enough, and frankly, so have I!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The referee steps in! It's a T.K.O., and nobody in this building is arguing!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That's the stoppage! The referee jumped in faster than my lunch break!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: It's over by stoppage! Somebody bring the loser a very comfortable chair!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The referee says no more! Technical knockout, folks, technically wonderful!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Stoppage! The referee has both arms wrapped around the problem!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: And the referee stops it! That's enough trips to the canvas for one night!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Waved off by the referee! Your winner by T.K.O.: {w}!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: T.K.O.! The referee calls it, and your winner is {w}!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: You did it, kid! The referee stops it and the night is yours!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The referee's done the kind thing, kid. Rest up. We'll see you back here.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The referee's counting! Get up, get up, the count won't wait!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: There's the count! The whole crowd is counting along with the referee!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: I'm counting along with the referee. I'm already two numbers behind.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Waved back in! The referee says fight on!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Up and waved back in! That's a fighter who heard every number!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The referee checks the eyes, likes the eyes, and away we go!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Back on the feet and back in the fight! The referee steps away!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The referee waved them back in. I waved too. Nobody waved back.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Back up already? I was still writing "oh no" in my notes.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That round's in the books: a clear ten-nine on the cards!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The judges agree on that one, folks! Ten-nine across the board!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Clean work in that round, and the scorecards are going to show it!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: All three judges' pencils moved the same way. Mine moved in a circle.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A ten-eight round! That knockdown did the judges' math for them!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Ten-eight on the cards! Put somebody down and the judges notice!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That's a ten-eight round, folks! A big swing on every scorecard!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Ten-eight. I wrote it as "big round, very big". Close enough.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The judges split on that round! Somebody's watching a different fight!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A split round! One judge saw it differently, and that judge may need glasses!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: One judge disagreed. I respect a judge with opinions.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Ten-ten! Dead even on the cards, and the judges look very pleased about it!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: An even round! Nobody earned it, nobody lost it, everybody's sweaty!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Ten-ten. I like a round that refuses to pick favourites.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The judges are unanimous! Your winner by unanimous decision: {w}!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: All three cards agree! By unanimous decision, your winner is {w}!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Three judges, one opinion! The unanimous decision goes to {w}!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: No arguments from the judges tonight! Unanimous decision for {w}!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A split decision! Two cards to one, and your winner is {w}!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The judges couldn't all agree, but two of them could! Split decision: {w}!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Split decision, folks! Somebody's arguing in the parking lot already. It's {w}!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A majority decision! Two judges say yes, one says even. Your winner: {w}!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Majority decision, folks! One judge saw a draw; the other two saw {w}!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The cards are read, and they're kind to you tonight! Decision win for {w}!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The cards are level! It's a draw, and the judges are leaving through the back!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A draw on the scorecards! Everybody fought, nobody won, everybody's invoiced!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The judges have spoken. I nodded like I agreed, and I did agree.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: I had it closer than that, but I had it on a napkin.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: A decision. I love a fight that needs paperwork at the end.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Bell! That round goes to {w}!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: There's the bell, and that round belongs to {w}!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That round's yours, kid! Bank it and breathe!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Round in the bag, kid! Do that again and we're done here!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That round got away from you, kid. Shake it off, the next bell's coming.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Time on the round, and I couldn't split them with a crowbar!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Quick breather. I'm using mine to find my pencil.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Round's over. My notes say "excellent" and then there's a drawing of a fish.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A few seconds to reset, folks. Chins up, here we go again!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: That round had a beginning, a middle, and an end. Strong structure.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The bell rang right on time. I appreciate punctuality.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: DOWN and OUT for the round! That's one round in the bank!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Knocked out! That takes the round, folks, but the night isn't over!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That's a knockout, and that's a round! Reset the bell, we go again!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: OUT for this round! The match isn't finished, but that round sure is!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: You took that round the loud way, kid! Now do it again!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: You got caught, kid. That's one round. Shake it off and win the next.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: One down! The rest of the cage just got a little roomier!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Eliminated! That fighter's done; everybody else, keep swinging!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Out goes one! The crowd counts the survivors, and so do I!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That's an elimination! One fewer critter in the cage!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: THAT'S THE FIGHT! Down and out, folks, and the whole place is ringing!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: KNOCKOUT! That's the end, that's the night, that's the headline!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: It's all over! That shot ended the argument and the evening!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: GOODNIGHT! A clean knockout, folks, and nobody's getting up from that!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: That ended suddenly. I had a whole paragraph prepared.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: A finish. I'll underline it, which is my highest honour.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: I didn't even have time to sharpen my pencil for the second half.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: All the way to the bell. Both of them have earned a sandwich.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: They went the distance. I went the distance too, in this chair.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Great fight. I'm putting it in my favourites, which is a sticky note.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A career begins tonight, folks! First walk to the cage, first lights, first everything!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Remember this one! A brand-new career makes its debut tonight!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Professional debut! The nerves are real, the cage is real, let's see what's real!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: This one's for the BELT, folks! Five rounds, one title, no refunds!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Championship night! The belt is on the table and both fighters can smell it!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: It's a TITLE FIGHT! Somebody polish the gold, somebody hold my jacket!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The champ is defending! Everybody wants that belt, and only one fighter has it!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Career night in the cage! The record's on the line and the promoter is watching!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Another step up the card, folks! Win here and the phone starts ringing!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Our career fighter makes the walk! Purse on the line, pride on the line!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Career fights have contracts. I have a contract too. It mentions snacks.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: I hear the promoter is watching. I'm sitting up straighter.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Another one for the record book! The career keeps climbing!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That's a career win, folks! The purse is earned and the phone is ringing!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Another win! I've lost count, which means it's a lot!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: NEW CHAMPION! Somebody bring the belt, and bring the big microphone!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The belt changes hands! A career just became a championship career!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A tough night for the career, kid. Heal up. The gym's open tomorrow.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That one goes in the loss column. Every champion has a few of those.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: So close to the gold, kid. The belt will still be there next time.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: A career win. I'll add it to my scrapbook, which is also a napkin.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Losses build character. I have a great deal of character.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Steam Vent! Stoke opens the pressure valve and the front row gets a facial!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: There's the Steam Vent! A scalding cone right in front of the newt!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Stoke the Fire! He's feeding the furnace, and the furnace is hungry!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: He just stoked his own fire. I can't even keep a candle lit.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Tide Spit! A glob of harbour water, lobbed with intent!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Dredge spat. I'm told that's legal and also a technique.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Anchor Drop! Dredge plants the claws and dares anybody to swing!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: He's dropped anchor! Hit him now and he'll hit you right back!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Gust Bomb! A ball of wind with a very bad attitude!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Gusto flaps one out! That Gust Bomb is looking for a face!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Hang Time! Gusto takes to the air and takes his time about it!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: He's hovering. I'd like to hover. My chair has other plans.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: BULLDOZE! Here comes Dozer, and he does not have brakes!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Dozer puts his head down and goes! Somebody move the furniture!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Dust Bowl! Dozer kicks up a cloud and everybody starts coughing!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: That dust cloud got into my notes. Now they're archaeology.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Sludge Lob! A gooey arc, and wherever it lands, the floor gets worse!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Slurry lobs the sludge! Watch your footing, folks, watch everybody's footing!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Drain Dive! Slurry slips under the floor and pops up somewhere rude!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: It went into the drain. I have so many questions about the plumbing.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Arc Lash! A little ball of lightning goes hunting!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Jitters lets an Arc Lash loose! That spark knows where you live!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Spring Pad down! Somebody's about to get launched, maybe on purpose!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: He put a trampoline in a cage fight. I support it completely.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Right in the steam! That vent cooked the whole front of the target!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Tide Spit lands! That's a faceful of cold harbour water!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Direct hit with spit. The crowd is torn between cheering and washing.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The Gust Bomb hits home! Blown back by a stiff breeze with opinions!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: That wind hit harder than my umbrella ever survived.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Bulldoze connects! Dozer just went through somebody like a front door!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Caught by the Bulldoze! That's a lot of Shovelsnout moving very fast!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Sludge Lob splashes down on target! That's going to be sticky for a while!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Arc Lash finds its mark! Zap, crackle, and a very surprised opponent!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Ghost Light catches up! That lantern never stops following!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The lantern caught them. I did say not to run in straight lines.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Out of the veil and into the target! Knell rings them on arrival!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The ability misses! Wasted on fresh air, and the cooldown starts anyway!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Whiffed the special! That's a long wait for the next one!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: That ability missed. It looked very confident about it, though.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The Ghost Light fizzles out! The lantern lost the scent!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Tide Spit splashes the floor instead! At least the floor is wet now!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Steam in the cage. My glasses fogged up, and I don't wear glasses.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: That spit left a puddle. The puddle is part of the fight now.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The Gust Bomb blew my notes into next week.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Dozer charged. The cage held. I held my breath.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: There's sludge on the floor now. I'm told that's the plan.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The spark followed them around. Sparks are very persistent.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Varga cut the angle. I cut my sandwich into angles. Similar energy.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: MELTDOWN! Stoke's boiler blows its top and everything nearby gets toasted!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The furnace door is OPEN! That's Meltdown, folks, and it is HOT!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: HIGH TIDE! The harbour comes over the wall and Dredge rides the wave!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Dredge calls in the tide! Everybody's ankle deep and the crab is smiling!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: HURRICANE STRUT! Gusto whips up a storm and struts right through it!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The wind's at Gusto's back now! Hurricane Strut, and the crowd's hair is ruined!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: LANDSLIDE! Dozer brings the whole hillside with him!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Here comes the Landslide! Rocks, dust, and one very determined Shovelsnout!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: OVERFLOW! The drains back up and Slurry surfs right out of them!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Slurry hits Overflow! A wave of sludge, and the floor is now a swamp!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: OVERCHARGE! Jitters lights up like the whole cannery's fuse box!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Jitters goes into Overcharge! Every hair in the building is standing up!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: I can feel the heat from up here. My notes are toasted.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: My shoes are wet. I'm in the booth. How are my shoes wet?

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: That's the windiest thing I've seen since the last time Gusto fought.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: I'm told that's a landslide. I'm told to stay in my seat.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The floor is sludge now. I'm keeping my feet up on the desk.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The lights flickered. I hope that was him and not the building.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Championship Rounds. He just got faster in the middle of a fight. Rude.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Born in a boiler room and raised on coal smoke: STOKE!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The newt with a furnace and a grudge! Turn up the heat for STOKE!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Hauled up from the harbour floor with a claw for every argument: DREDGE!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: He's patient, he's armoured, and he's never late for the tide: DREDGE!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: He styles his crest before every fight and after every hit: GUSTO!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Quick wings, loud mouth, perfect hair: the Showboat Tern, GUSTO!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Shovel first, questions never! Make some room for DOZER!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: He dug through three walls to get here tonight: it's DOZER!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Straight out of the storm drain, slick and smiling: SLURRY!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Mind the puddles, folks, they're probably Slurry. Here comes SLURRY!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: One part jellyfish, three parts battery, all nerves: JITTERS!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: He's buzzing, he's blinking, he's somehow already moving: JITTERS!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Every time Stoke walks out, the booth gets two degrees warmer.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Dredge waved at me once. It took four seconds. Very thorough.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Gusto signed my notebook before I could ask him not to.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Dozer bumped the door frame on the way in. The door frame lost.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Slurry left a trail on the way in. I'm not stepping in it.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Jitters is vibrating. I think that's excitement. I hope that's excitement.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Varga warmed up with forty kicks. I warmed up with forty crackers.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: VARGA wins! The Cage Rules guest goes home with his house rules intact!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Your winner, by technique and very sore shins: VARGA!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Varga takes it! Four limbs, one plan, and the plan worked!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: KNELL wins! The Hollow Diver rings the last bell of the night!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Your winner, from the bottom of the harbour: KNELL!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Knell takes it! Nobody's home in that helmet, and it still won!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: And that's your winner, folks! Raise the arm and raise the roof!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Winner, winner, cannery dinner! What a performance!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: There's your winner! Somebody start the victory music, the good one!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The fight is won! Bring out the trophy, or at least a trophy-shaped crate!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: First touch of the night! Somebody's warmed up and somebody's not!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: And the first clean shot lands! The book is open, folks!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: First bruise of the fight! Glandco reminds you that bruises are temporary!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: First hit. I've written "one". This is going very well.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: You landed first, kid! Now don't get comfortable!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: They got there first, kid. That's information, not a verdict.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: GUARD BREAK! The shell cracks and the door is wide open!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That guard just gave out! Stamina's gone and so is the defence!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The guard is broken! Somebody's standing there with nothing but hope!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The guard broke. I could hear it from here. It sounded expensive.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Their arms said "no more blocking". Their arms were right.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Your guard's gone, kid! Get out of there!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Grabbed and thrown! Somebody just took the express route across the cage!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: THROWN! A handful of fighter, flung like a sack of fish!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Snatched up and tossed! Guarding doesn't help when they just pick you up!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Up and over! That throw had a destination in mind!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: That was a throw. I wrote it down in throwing letters.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Three clean in a row! That's a string, folks, that's a real string!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Bang, bang, BANG! The whole set lands!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Four hits, no reply! Somebody call a timeout! We don't have timeouts!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: That combination had more steps than my morning routine.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: I counted the hits. I'm going to need a bigger number.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: And the finisher lands on the end of it! Beautiful, brutal arithmetic!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: PARRIED! Slapped away at the very last moment!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: What a parry! That attack bounced off like it hit a church door!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: A parry. I tried that once with a pigeon. The pigeon won.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Another parry! They're reading everything tonight!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: DOWN! That's a knockdown, and it's going straight onto the scorecards!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Knocked DOWN! The judges are writing that one in capital letters!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: DOWN they go! The referee's on it, folks, here comes the count!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Off the feet! That's a knockdown, and the referee is right there!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Flat on the canvas! Get up, get up, it's not over!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Down AGAIN! That's not a stumble anymore, that's a pattern!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The health bar's flashing, folks! One more good shot and that's it!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Somebody's running low. I'm also running low, on pencils.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: You're in the red, kid! Guard up and pick your moment!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: They're nearly done, kid! Don't rush it, finish it!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Both of them on the edge! The next clean hit wins it!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Ten seconds! Throw what you've got, the clock isn't waiting!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Ten seconds left in the round! Make it count, make it loud!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Here comes the ten-second warning! Last chance to leave a mark!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Ten seconds. Just enough time for one more bad decision.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Next round! Fresh bell, same fighters, brand-new problems!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Here we go again! The bell rings, the critters swing!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Final round! Everything they've got left goes on the table now!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: This is the last round, folks! No more saving it for later!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: And we're underway! Touch gloves and get to work!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: FIGHT! The bell's rung, the crowd's up, and the cage door is shut!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: It's a championship fight, folks! Every round tonight is worth gold!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Match point, folks! One more round win and somebody takes the fight!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: A TAUNT! Bold choice, folks, very bold, possibly unwise!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Showboating in the middle of a fight! The crowd loves it, the opponent doesn't!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: A taunt. I taunt my kettle sometimes. It boils anyway.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Taunt, meet fist! That's what happens when you show off!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Big wind-up! Everything's going into this one!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Here comes the heavy! The whole body is loading up!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Stamina's running dry! Every swing from here is on credit!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: They're out of breath. I'm out of breath just narrating it.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Stoke fights like a boiler with the safety valve removed: all pressure, all the time.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Watch the Furnace Haymaker. Stoke winds it up long, and it lands longer!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Jab, cross, hook: Stoke throws them in that order every time, and it still works!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That chimney on Stoke's head puffs harder the angrier he gets. It's puffing now!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Stoke's furnace is glowing. I keep wanting to roast something on it.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Stoke's tail is short. His temper is shorter. I've measured both.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Dredge is slow on the feet but fast with the claws. Don't stand in front of him!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That big crusher claw does the talking. The little claw does the paperwork!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Hitting Dredge on the shell is like knocking on a bank vault!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Dredge loves a long fight. The longer it goes, the more the tide comes in!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Dredge's eyes are on stalks. He can watch the fight and the snack stand at once.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The barnacles on Dredge are glowing. I hope that's normal for barnacles.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Gusto's quick on the wing and quicker with the mouth. The kicks are fast too!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Gusto hates getting pinned down. Keep him moving and he's dangerous!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Those long legs are pure reach. Gusto kicks from a different postcode!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Light frame, big heart, bigger ego: that's Gusto in a nutshell!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Gusto checked his watch in the middle of the round. He doesn't have a watch.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Gusto's crest hasn't moved all fight. I think it's lacquered.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Dozer doesn't do angles. Dozer does straight lines through whatever's there!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Get Dozer turning and he's slow. Let him charge and he's a freight train!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That shovel snout isn't decoration. Dozer digs opponents out of position!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The heaviest hitter on the card, folks, and he knows exactly one direction!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Dozer's headlamp is on. I don't know who it's for, but I appreciate it.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Dozer snuffled the floor. I believe he's looking for truffles.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Slurry's whole body is a weapon: head, tail, fangs, and the floor it leaves behind!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That head butt reaches farther than it looks. Slurry lives on it!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Slurry wants you standing in the sludge. Every puddle is a plan!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Slurry stays low and sneaky. Good luck finding a clean target on that wyrm!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Slurry sways when it's thinking. Slurry is always thinking.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: I tried to describe Slurry's shape. I wrote "long" and stopped there.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Jitters is small, jumpy and loaded with volts. Every touch comes with a buzz!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Don't let Jitters get underneath you. That little jelly hits harder than he looks!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The coil inside Jitters is glowing brighter. That's a jelly with a charge!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Slap, double slap, headbonk! Jitters' whole offence sounds like a cartoon!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Jitters hasn't stopped bouncing since the bell. I'm tired just watching.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Jitters has antennae. They're for balance, or for receiving radio. Maybe both.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Sizzle! That's a burn that ticks away and slows the stamina too!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Somebody's Sizzling! Five seconds of burn and a very short temper!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Sizzle. I can smell it from here. It smells like breakfast.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Soaked! Slower feet, shorter dodges, and they'll fly farther when hit!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That fighter's Soaked through! And water plus volts is a bad combination!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Soaked. I'd offer a towel, but I'm using mine as a napkin.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Jolted! Little shocks every second, and those cooldowns crawl!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: They're Jolted! Every pulse locks them up for a heartbeat!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Jolted. I touched the booth railing once. I understand completely.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Gunked! Sludge that burns, a guard that costs more, healing that barely works!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: That's Gunked! The guard just got expensive and the medicine stopped working!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Gunked. That fighter now looks like my kitchen sink.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Caked in grit! Less poise, slower recovery, and dodging costs a fortune!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Caked! That mud makes every heavy hit stagger them harder!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Caked. I don't recommend it as a skincare routine.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Winded! No stamina coming back, and every dodge costs double!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: They're Winded! Easy to shove, easy to knock around, hard to escape!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Winded. I get winded on the stairs up to this booth.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: ELEMENTAL REACTION! Two elements meet and nobody's happy about it!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Whoa, a reaction! The elements just picked a fight of their own!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: STEAM BURST! Fire meets water and the whole cage turns into a kettle!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: BACKDRAFT! The wind feeds the flames and the flames say thank you!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: MUDBOUND! Brine and grit make mud, and mud makes everybody slow!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: DILUTE! The water washes the sludge out in one big splash!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: CATALYZE! The volts cook the sludge faster! That stings twice!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: CRUST! Sludge and grit set hard, and nobody's dodging out of that shell!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: SPRAY! The wind flings the sludge everywhere! Everywhere, folks!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: SANDBLAST! A face full of grit, and the guard is wide open!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: BELL RINGER! Scrap meets spectral and the whole head rings!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: GRAVE CHILL! Spectral cold in harbour water, right down to the bones!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: CRACK GUARD! Scrap into grit, and that guard just split down the middle!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The arena joins the fight! Watch your feet, folks, the floor has opinions!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Hazard's live! Somebody's about to get a very rude surprise!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: The arena moved again. I've stopped trusting the furniture.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Here comes the gust! Hold on to something that isn't the edge!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The plate is live! Stay on the rubber mats, kids, the steel is cooking!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The tide's in the gutter! Everybody's ankles, consider yourselves warned!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Somebody scooped up the pickup! Free stuff always tastes better!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Health pickup grabbed! That's a second wind, straight off the floor!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Boing! Off the Spring Pad and straight up!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Someone just used the trampoline. Respect.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Tag! Fresh legs come into the cage!

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: The tag is made! In comes the partner, swinging!

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: They tagged out. I'd like to tag out of this booth for a sandwich.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: I think the cage just moved. Barnaby says it was only the camera.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: I thought Brine was a drink. Barnaby says it is not a drink.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: If the floor starts talking, Barnaby, I am letting you answer it.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Haunted lasts five seconds: cooldowns recover slower and healing is twenty percent weaker.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Haunted slows cooldown recovery by a quarter and cuts received healing by a fifth.

items.speaker: kendall
items.text: Haunted slows your cooldowns down. Mine are slow already.

items.speaker: barnaby
items.text: Port Hook! Knell's quick light hook keeps the opponent turning.
